run_manual_control: run the manual control script to interact with a gym_minigrid environment using keyboard controls
run_with_custom_env: run the manual control script with a custom gym environment name via the --env argument
run_with_seed: run the manual control script with a fixed random seed for reproducible environment generation
run_agent_view: run the manual control script in agent view mode to see the partially observable agent perspective
review_key_handler: review the key_handler function that maps keyboard events to environment actions like move, pickup, and drop
